name: Naive (demand plan as-is)
notes: Strawman: demand plan laid out as-is (AZAP week honoured, fastest capable line, no changeover/CIP/optimization).

formulas.recipe_changes: Count of adjacent production transitions on the same line where recipe/SKU family differs (changeover flags: flavor/organic/cinnamon; else SKU change that is not format-only).
formulas.format_changes: Count of adjacent production transitions with packaging format change (topload / TTP / FFS / casepacker flags from changeover standards).
formulas.total_co_hours: Sum of estimated changeover hours per transition from standards table, else configurable defaults by CO type. Idle gaps alone are not counted.
formulas.cip_count: Number of CIP blocks in the horizon.
formulas.cip_hours: Sum of CIP block durations (end_h - start_h).
formulas.cip_forfeited_h: For each CIP: max(0, line_cip_interval_h - run_hours_since_last_cip). Cleaning earlier than the interval forfeits unused dirty-time budget. REPORTED ONLY - the scored version of this metric is cip_forfeited_kg.
formulas.cip_forfeited_kg: Forfeited CIP dirty-time converted to KILOGRAMS of lost production, valuing each forfeited hour at that line's average run rate (kg/h).
formulas.trial_disruptions: Production blocks immediately before/after a trial on the same line that require a changeover (SKU differs) or are split by the trial.
formulas.maint_aligned: Maintenance blocks whose window overlaps a CIP on the same line (or within +/- align_tolerance_h). Higher is better.
formulas.maint_conflicts: Maintenance blocks that overlap production, trial, or contractor on the same line. Higher is worse.
formulas.orders_at_risk: Orders whose scheduled completion is within at_risk_h of due end but still on time. n/a if demand data missing.
formulas.orders_late: Orders with scheduled completion after due end, or unmet qty below min. n/a if demand data missing.
formulas.excess_inventory_kg: Sum of max(0, produced_qty - qty_max) across orders. n/a if no max bound.
